notes.subject: טובו / יפיו — bakeng sa yena kgahlanong le bakeng sa bona
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV 'his' (Elohim/Yahwe); JPS/BSB 'their' (setšhaba) — dithoto tše pedi di a dumelwa

notes.subject: ינובב
notes.rationale: 'go phunyeletša' (YLT/ASV) kgahlanong le 'go gopolla/kgokgontšha' (KJV 'make cheerful') — בחורים e ka ba bahlankana goba bao ba kgethwago

notes.subject: בחורים / בתלות
notes.rationale: phapano ya bahlankana le dikgarebe — go swana le ge Sefora a bolela ka Dina (Gen 34) — e laetša kgetho ya setšhaba

translation: Gore gose gakaaka bobebo bakeng sa yena, gomme gose gakaaka botle bakeng sa yena! Bogobe bo tla phunyeletša ⟨את⟩ bahlankana, gomme missa ya walane e tla phunyeletša ⟨את⟩ dikgarebe.
